metadata.description: Claude Code plugins published from the aws-samples/amazon-nova-samples repository.

plugins.name: nova-prompting
plugins.description: Prompt optimization skills for Amazon Nova 1 and Nova 2 Lite (/nova1-prompt, /nova2-prompt).

plugins.name: titan-nova-mme-migration
plugins.description: Migrate Amazon Bedrock embedding code from Titan Text V2 / Titan Multimodal G1 to Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings.

plugins.name: gemini-to-nova-migration
plugins.description: Migrate Google Gemini 2.0/2.5/3.x Python code and prompts to Amazon Nova 2 Lite (boto3 Bedrock Runtime).

plugins.name: openai-to-nova-migration
plugins.description: Migrate OpenAI GPT-4o/4.1/5.x code and prompts (via the OpenAI API or hosted on Amazon Bedrock, incl. GPT-5.5/5.4 and gpt-oss) to Amazon Nova 2 Lite.
